**In one line**: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to invest around $3 billion in SB Energy, a SoftBank-linked power company, as part of an OpenAI data center deal.

### Key points
- According to The Information, Nvidia is said to be discussing a roughly $3 billion investment in SB Energy.
- The investment is reported to be tied to infrastructure for OpenAI's data center expansion.
- SB Energy is a SoftBank-affiliated energy and power-infrastructure business, positioning it near the data center power supply chain.

### Why it matters
The bottleneck for AI data centers is increasingly power, not just chips. Nvidia backing energy infrastructure directly signals a more vertical bet — reaching beyond GPU supply into the electricity and sites needed to sustain OpenAI-scale compute demand.
